statement: קופת גמל להשקעה לחיסכון ארוך טווח לילד

source.title: National Insurance Institute, תכנית חיסכון לכל ילד (programme page): opened "בקופת גמל או בבנק לפי בחירתכם"
source.quote: הביטוח הלאומי פותח תכנית חיסכון אישית לכל ילד הזכאי לקצבת ילדים עד הגיעו לגיל 18, בקופת גמל או בבנק לפי בחירתכם.

regulator.notes: The National Insurance Institute runs the programme under the National Insurance Law and the Ministry of Finance (Accountant General) sets the approved list by tender. The money sits in a provident fund classified 'קופת גמל להשקעה - חסכון לילד', whose managing company is under the CMA Commissioner's supervision (Harel's bylaw refers to 'הממונה'); the CMA is the regulator of the fund that holds the money.

source.title: תקנות הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל) (דמי ניהול), התשע"ב-2012 (קובץ התקנות 7131), p.4, reg. 2(א)(2)
source.publisher: Reshumot (Ministry of Justice) – official gazette file service

deposit.notes: The legal cap on the fee from each deposit (fee regulations reg. 2(א)(2)), on the same reasoning as the balance cap. Until 21 NII bears the management cost (CS-18). Each manager sets its own rate (Harel's bylaw: none; CS-30).

source.title: תקנות הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל) (דמי ניהול), התשע"ב-2012 (קובץ התקנות 7131), p.4, reg. 2(א)(1)
source.publisher: Reshumot (Ministry of Justice) – official gazette file service

balance.notes: The legal cap on the yearly fee from the balance (fee regulations reg. 2(א)(1)): the child-savings fund is a kupat gemel lehashkaa to which every kupat gemel lehashkaa provision applies (circular 2022-9-29 s.1), and the CMA standard child bylaw caps the rate at the legal maximum (s.31.1). Until the child is 21 NII bears the management cost and pays the fund itself (CS-18); after 21 the fee comes out of the savings, within this cap; a manager chosen in the 2016 tender may not raise it above the rate it undertook in the tender and charged before 21 (CS-18). Each manager sets its own rate (Harel's and Altshuler Shaham's: CS-30).

labels: 25% of the real gain, withheld by the fund: the Ordinance's rule for a lump sum from a kupat gemel lehashkaa, which the fund is by law, the regulator's circular and the Ministry of Finance's tender answers (TXK-23, TXK-07, s.125ג(ב)); no Tax Authority text names child savings (TXK OQ1); method G-17
the annuity route NII describes has no clear statutory basis (TXK-25, TXK OQ1); not computed

source.title: National Insurance Institute, child savings: withdrawal page (from 18 with a parent's signature, from 21 alone); law 74ג(ב)
source.quote: את כספי החיסכון ניתן למשוך רק כשהילד יגיע לגיל 18 (בתום החודש בו ימלאו לו 18), למעט במקרים חריגים.

age.notes: Redemption age: the child may withdraw from 18 (from the end of the month of the 18th birthday), whole or in part, with a parent's signature until 21 and alone from 21 (CS-14). Any withdrawal before 21 forfeits the NIS 582 (2026) age-21 grant (CS-13).

source.title: תקנות מס הכנסה (כללים לאישור ולניהול קופות גמל) (תיקון מס' 3), התשס"ה-2005, קובץ התקנות 6380 (10.4.2005), סריקת רשומות, file p.3 (gazette p.603), reg. 9 (in reg. 41יא '5 ימי עסקים' becomes '4 ימי עסקים', with the deferral to the fourth business day of the month); reg. 41יא itself as substituted by קובץ התקנות 6332, file p.19 (gazette p.873), reg. 44
source.quote: רשאית הקופה לדחות את מועד התשלום ליום העסקים הרביעי באותו חודש

payout_business_days.notes: Rule 41יא(א) of the 1964 Income Tax Rules: a provident fund pays a withdrawal within 4 business days of the day the request reaches it; if that date falls in the month's first three business days it may defer to the 4th business day of the month. The law's timetable for every fund, not one company's (scope pass 2026-10-25). The child-savings fund is a kupat gemel lehashkaa (circular 2022-9-29 s.1), and the CMA standard child-savings bylaw says the same: within four business days, to the member's bank account only (s.10.4-10.5). The request goes to the fund, not to NII.

lawful_exit.text: from 18 with a parent's signature, from 21 alone; a withdrawal before 21 forfeits the age-21 grant; before 18 only to fund the child's medical needs where a condition endangers the child's life, body or mind, with an NII-appointed doctor's approval (CS-15); no withdrawal for financial hardship; money not withdrawn keeps being managed in the fund, with no new deposits (CS-16)

source.title: Income Tax Ordinance, s.3(ה4)(3) (Tax Authority's text, p.21): the charge applies to sums an individual "משך" from a kupat gemel lehashkaa

switch_is_tax_event.notes: Not a withdrawal: the provident track is a kupat gemel lehashkaa to which every provision for that product applies (TXK-23, the regulator's circular), so a track switch or a move to another kupat gemel lehashkaa, a regular one too after 18 (CS-16), is not taxed (TXK-04). Replaces the 2026-10-22 'unknown', which predates TXK-23.

transfer_routes.condition: to another provident fund on NII's approved list; the parent acts before 18, the child from 18; never to a bank

eligibility.text: every child for whom child allowance is paid, from birth to 18, with no action needed; the parent who receives the allowance chooses a listed provident fund and one of its tracks (low, medium or increased risk) within six months of birth, and may turn on the addition from the child allowance at any time; if no choice is made the money goes to a provident fund by default, in the increased-risk track or the older sibling's fund and track; no other money can be deposited, by anyone

protection.text: the money belongs to the child, is held in trust by the parent who receives the allowance and cannot be transferred, pledged or attached; the fund's assets are held in trust, separately from the managing company's property, and if the company fails management moves to another company; there is no floor under the value in the provident option (what each company's default track holds is its own term, CS-09)
